description: Safe scene-edit facade. It uses the authenticated Premiere UXP bridge when connected and explicitly confirmed; CEP fallback is intentionally withheld because synchronous scene detection can block the panel.

confirm_non_undoable.description: Must be true because the host operation mutates the project and is not claimed undoable.

mode.description: How Premiere should materialize detected edits on the current native selection.

operation_id.description: Optional idempotency key sent to the UXP bridge.

name: detect_scene_edits

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Detect Scene Edits
